reason: The full 293-method scenario registry found four earlier live tests that still expected the deliberate Steering Modifier 2 clear to remove Steering. Release 90.44 intentionally preserves that stateful layer.
preserved_intent: 90.14 P12 still requires the missed pad-click state and Modifier 2 to be removed; releasing the remaining driver must settle at Base plus Steering with no held output.
90.16 X3 still tests both A9 behaviors for a held center click, verifies click-layer cleanup and confirms a fresh click works; the final driver/pad release leaves only Base plus Steering.
90.17 S1 still checks the outer click disappears before its 5 ms re-entry delay and returns only under the selected A9 behavior; final release clears all pad helpers and held output.
90.33 L2 now requires quick cleanup to remove Gyro and all temporary layers while retaining Steering without beep or haptic. Historical frozen fallback expectations remain unchanged.
